title: Weird Money Mod
description: In game craftable/tradeable money you can spend for in game items! Check description!
body:
**Main thing**

**You NEED to craft the money block that is needed to trade with villagers.**

So basicaly this mod adds in game money to trade with the money dealer to get op loot and stuff.

This is my first ever uploaded mod and the first mod I locked in to make. After 10 downloads i will update and add the ability to split money.

**MONEY**

There are 6 bills you can get! 

You can craft 1$ bills but you need to trade to get any higher dollar bills  or items.

The texture was made by me but insperation from here: https://stock.adobe.com/tw/video/pixel-art-dollar-bill-moving-up-and-down-2d-animation-15fps/487265212

Anyway enjoy and make sure to get wood for 1$ recipee.
